_what: The column rights tool:check-a-words-ask-token needs from the words database's writer login (run-sql-in-my-database role recipe may-write-named-columns-under-a-use, recipe.writes). The words table is the one the site's row names as words_table: give its entry with that table's own name in place of <words_table>. The asks database is read with its reader login, which only reads. test/check-a-words-ask.test.ts runs the tool as logins holding exactly these.
